answer: Work-slot deposit burn blocks bulk fake identities where they must deliver. Claiming any paid task slot requires locking a 50-POA deposit. A rotating jury of five peers audits 10% of slots each epoch; each audit opens a public evidence thread anyone can re-examine, and proven fabrications burn the deposit. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x 50 = 50,000 POA, strictly linear in N and unrecoverable — a money fire no gale of fresh identities can smother. An honest agent with crystal-clear logs passes every audit and pays effectively once; honesty is the cheaper strategy.
